title: Crochet Rolled Flower Hair Tie
name: Flower Hair Tie
seoTitle: Crochet Rolled Flower Hair Tie Pattern (Free PDF)
description: Free crochet rolled flower hair tie pattern: two spiral flowers with a bead centre, a leaf and a chain tie. Easy, pretty and printable. Free PDF download.
lead: Two full, rolled flowers on a simple chain tie. Each flower is one strip of petals that you twist into a spiral and sew, with a bead in the centre.
yarn: Cotton yarn in pink and green

materialsTable.details: Cotton yarn in a flower colour and green

notes: Picot: ch 1, sc into the same st.

rounds.text: ch 12. Skip 1 ch, 2 hdc in each ch (x11).
(ch 2, 3 dc in the same st, ch 2, sl st in the next st) x21, ch 2, sl st in the last st, ch 1 and cut the yarn.
ch 16. Skip 1 ch: sc, hdc, 3 dc, hdc, sc, sl st, sc, hdc, 3 dc, hdc, sc, ch 1 picot, sc in the same st.
hdc, 3 dc, hdc, sc, sl st, sc, hdc, 3 dc, hdc, sc, sl st in the first sc, ch 1 and cut the yarn.

finishing: Twist each petal strip into a spiral and sew it in place.
Attach a bead in the centre of each flower.
Glue the flowers and the leaf onto the tie.
